key_insight: GGPO trains off-policy reasoning models by contrasting KL-adjusted rewards within prompt-level response groups, avoiding high-variance learner-to-behavior importance weights.
engineering_relevance: GGPO offers a way to reuse stale or fixed response data for verifiable-reward training while remaining robust to policy mismatch in the reported experiments.
method: Minimize a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards across responses to the same prompt.
Derive the objective from KL-regularized policy optimization, with an exact on-policy population optimality-gap interpretation.
Refresh the reference policy, supported by Gibbs-target composition and conditional finite-data reward bounds.
evidence_signal: Math-reasoning experiments report gains over GRPO and AGRO under training–inference mismatch and fixed offline data; reference refresh raises the five-benchmark problem-weighted average from 32.96 to 46.58.
watch_item: Reference refresh is consequential, and theoretical reward guarantees require coverage and mismatch-control assumptions that may not hold for arbitrary offline data.
paper_title: Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization for Off-Policy RL with Verifiable Rewards
